meta.title: Fix Gantt performance by removing useMouse from every column
meta.body_summary: Fix Gantt chart performance by replacing per-column useMouse hook with hover events, claiming ~10,000x reduction in re-renders.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot removed per-column mouse tracking hooks; maintainer found helper disappeared, fixed in PR, but PR closed without merge after ~18 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 6464 changed lines, most are from an added package-lock.json (6443) while the actual Gantt fix is only 21 lines. This small‑scope performance PR closed without merge after a regression was reported and fixed, which is inconsistent with typical quick merges for tiny fixes.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer reported that the GanttAddFeatureHelper no longer appeared when hovering on columns after the code removal.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduction of re‑renders from ~21,900/s to only 2 per hover (~10,000x improvement).
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed the PR without merge after bug was reported and fixed; no further comment or acceptance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Frontend performance optimization via hook removal in a React Gantt component; agent introduced a UI regression (missing helper) that required targeted fix, but ultimately PR was not merged.

detection_detail.manual_testing: Maintainer tested the UI and observed that the GanttAddFeatureHelper disappeared when hovering on columns.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Reproduced by maintainer via manual interaction; no automated test or benchmark for performance gain or regression.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After maintainer reported the missing helper, Copilot added a height fix in the same PR.

core_change_summary.description: Removed useMouse, useThrottle, useWindowScroll from GanttColumn, replacing with onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave for hover state; removed top prop from GanttAddFeatureHelper and centered it; later added explicit height to fix visibility regression.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: package-lock.json added with 6443 lines likely due to new dependencies; not directly related to the performance fix.
change_trajectory: Removed per-column mouse tracking hooks from GanttColumn.
After maintainer feedback, fixed GanttAddFeatureHelper visibility by adding explicit height.

review_signals.action_taken: Copilot fixed by adding explicit height in follow-up commit.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed fix for GanttAddFeatureHelper visibility by adding height to container div.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with performance fix removing useMouse hooks.
Maintainer reported a regression where helper disappeared.
Copilot committed a fix within hours.
No further review or merge activity for ~18 days; maintainer closed the PR without merge.
